description: This file defines configuration options for pandas-on-Spark, including classes, functions, and a set of configurable options with validation, as well as utility functions for managing these options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Class representing a configurable option with validation logic.

classes.name: OptionError
classes.description: Custom exception class for option-related errors.

classes.name: DictWrapper
classes.description: Class providing attribute-style access to the options dictionary.

methods.name: show_options
methods.description: Displays all available options in a formatted table.

methods.name: get_option
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified configuration option.

methods.name: set_option
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified configuration option.

methods.name: reset_option
methods.description: Resets a configuration option to its default value.

methods.name: option_context
methods.description: Context manager for temporarily setting options within a 'with' block.

methods.name: _check_option
methods.description: Internal function to validate if an option key exists.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Function to run internal doctests and Spark session tests.
